info.title: Performance Run and Baseline Management API
info.description: Candidate contract only. Run lifecycle and baseline administration remain independent of measurement quality, SLO and regression verdicts. See docs/run-management-api.md.

tags.name: Baselines
tags.description: Explicit, authenticated baseline creation and lifecycle administration.

post.description: Select approved, versioned catalogue/environment/policy resources. No caller-supplied commands, target URLs or credentials. Idempotency is scoped to authenticated principal and this operation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque client-generated key. Reuse for retries of the same parsed JSON request; use a new key for a new run.

201.description: Durably accepted run. An idempotent replay returns the original 201 snapshot and headers; GET returns current state.

Location.description: Relative URI of the accepted run.

Idempotency-Key-Expires-At.description: UTC expiration, at least 24 hours after original acceptance; unchanged on replay.

413.description: Request exceeds the 64 KiB UTF-8 body limit; code BAD_REQUEST.

415.description: Only application/json is accepted; code BAD_REQUEST.

200.description: Current consistent snapshot; revision increases on each persisted mutation.

get.summary: List immutable artifacts visible for a run
get.description: Returns the current principal-scoped artifact-reference snapshot in ascending artifact-ID order. The collection can be empty or partial while the run is active. References are evidence metadata, not object bytes, credentials, signed URLs, lifecycle completion, or analysis verdicts.

200.description: Current artifact-reference snapshot for the visible run.

post.description: No request body. CREATED or VALIDATING is aborted synchronously before dispatch and returns 200. PROVISIONING or a later active state enters CANCELLING and returns 202. Repeated CANCELLING returns 202 without mutation; already ABORTED returns 200 without mutation; any other terminal state returns 409 RUN_TERMINAL. Stop/cleanup after dispatch is asynchronous, so 202 does not mean execution has stopped.

200.description: Cancellation completed before dispatch, or the Run was already ABORTED; response state ABORTED.

202.description: Cancellation durably requested; response state CANCELLING.

post.summary: Create a baseline candidate from completed evidence
post.description: Creates one immutable baseline version in CANDIDATE. The authenticated actor is recorded by the server; it is never accepted from the body. A repeated ID/version returns 409 even when the body is identical; after an uncertain response, read the exact resource.

201.description: Baseline candidate created with revision one.

Location.description: Relative URI of the created baseline version.

post.summary: Apply one revision-checked baseline lifecycle decision
post.description: The server records the authenticated actor. Clients provide the observed revision, target state, reason and qualification evidence only when the transition requires it. Retrying after an uncertain response starts with GET of this exact version.

200.description: Transition committed and lifecycle event appended.

get.summary: Resolve an exact CI request to its native Run
get.description: Requires current service run:read permission and independently retained service binding. Unknown, unbound, invisible, revoked and unavailable mapping all return the same NOT_FOUND 404; a provider outage returns 503. A resource-independent operation denial may return 403 before lookup. No-store applies to every response. See docs/service-identity.md.

200.description: Authorized current observation. All responses MUST use Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.name: requestIssuer
parameters.description: Exact immutable Integration request identity; never dereference or treat as authorization.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Exact immutable Integration request identity; never dereference or treat as authorization.

get.summary: Read verified identity and service access for a Run
get.description: Requires current service run:read permission and independently retained service binding. Unknown, unbound, invisible, revoked and unavailable mapping all return the same NOT_FOUND 404; a provider outage returns 503. A resource-independent operation denial may return 403 before lookup. No-store applies to every response. See docs/service-identity.md.

200.description: Authorized current observation. All responses MUST use Cache-Control: no-store.

get.summary: Read the immutable historical Run comparison or explicit evidence availability
get.description: Authorize the Run and every disclosed evidence object. Unknown/invisible Run is the uniform scoped 404. Never rebuild from current catalog or baseline state; no-store applies to all responses. See docs/run-comparison.md.

200.description: Immutable available comparison, or current INCOMPLETE/INACCESSIBLE observation without evidence. Maximum serialized body is 2 MiB; never truncate.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque credential verified by the server; token issuance is outside this contract. TLS is required outside isolated development.

RunResolution.description: Exact retained Integration request issuer/id to native Run association. No latest-attempt selection, redirects, credentials or authority recovery.

RunAccess.description: Read-only current authorization observation. Server-owned bindings and verified identities; never a capability or an authorization input. Recheck current grants on every operation. Legacy unbound Runs are not inferred into services.

RunComparison.description: AVAILABLE is the immutable retained comparison. Other states are current availability observations with no evidence or performance verdict. See docs/run-comparison.md.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, duplicate object keys, invalid headers/path, or unsupported request body.

Forbidden.description: Caller lacks permission for the requested operation or selected resources.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Key conflicts with another request or the identical request is still in progress.

Retry-After.description: Required for REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS, absent for a payload conflict.

ValidationFailed.description: Request schema or synchronous resource validation failed; no mutation was committed.

RateLimited.description: Rate limited; retry after the indicated delay.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error; recover an outcome-uncertain mutation using its documented read operation.

Unavailable.description: Temporarily unavailable; retry after the indicated delay.

NotFound.description: Resource is absent or not visible to this caller.

RunTerminal.description: Cancellation lost the race to another terminal state.

BaselineExists.description: The principal already owns this immutable baseline ID and version.

RequestTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the 64 KiB UTF-8 body limit; code BAD_REQUEST.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Only application/json is accepted; code BAD_REQUEST.

BaselineTransitionConflict.description: The observed revision is stale or the requested lifecycle edge is not allowed.

ScopedNotFound.description: Uniform absence or scoped denial; no resource-specific details. Request ID is independent per HTTP request.
